blindSummary:
This territory is an integral overseas part of a distant metropolitan state; the metropolitan state's law fully applies. The risk picture is adjusted for a more conservative local social climate and thinner services than in the metropole.

The evidence base for this territory is the metropolitan state's framework as applied on the ground, with those local deviations; the territory has no independent legal framework of its own.
blindOutOfScope: Overseas territory of a distant metropolitan state; local deviations noted in the summary.
blindSourceSummaries: News feature (Jan 2018, metropolitan context): trans women incarcerated in the metropolitan state on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal gray area - relevant to this territory because the metropolitan state's law applies here in full.

The metropolitan state's detention watchdog's opinion of 25 May 2021 on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty (applicable to this territory): serious violations of fundamental rights persist across all places of detention, based on ~40 referrals since 2010.

Legal-equality tracking site (Sept 2023): interview with a founder of a local LGBT association (founded Feb 2022) - the challenge of getting community members out beyond festive events; the group runs a twice-weekly meeting space in the territory's main commercial city; notes the gap between LGBT visibility among the territory's diaspora in the metropolitan state and the situation on the ground.

Local media outlet (May 2025, in the metropolitan language): the territory's first LGBT+ centre - a diversity-and-inclusion resource centre - opened 24 April 2024, inaugurated by a visiting metropolitan minister; part of the metropolitan state's programme to establish an LGBT+ centre in each of its overseas territories; responds to a 2023 mapping of anti-LGBT violence by a local human-rights association.
Local newspaper (in the metropolitan language): coverage of the metropolitan minister's visit for the opening of the new LGBT centre to strengthen inclusion - local reporting on the same initiative.

Legal-equality tracking site (March 2025): three local LGBT groups partnering on social activities for the territory's LGBT community; a gay-friendly festive day on a smaller neighbouring island; discussion of approaching the tourism committee about gay-friendly tourism.
